Report vertical-ordering inconsistencies in landmarks (no correction)

Source: R/consistency.R
check_landmark_order.Rd

Dry-run companion to correct_landmark_order(): returns which specimens have impossible dorsal-ventral landmark orderings and how many landmarks would be moved, without altering the data.

Usage

check_landmark_order(landmarks, chains = .FM_ORDER_CHAINS)

Arguments

landmarks

A fishmorph_landmarks object.

chains

Chains to check (see correct_landmark_order()).

Value

A data frame (specimen, n_corrected, flagged), the rows with flagged = TRUE being the inconsistent specimens.
